profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lutron
profile.summary:
I am a Senior at Penn State majoring in Computer Science and minoring in Math. 

Between school and personal projects I have some experience with .NET development using WPF, database design and management (specfically SQL using SQLite), Machine Learning in Python, algorithm design, and other general software engineering  and development skills. 

I am comfortable with C, C#, and Python and I am currently also learning Swift and SwiftUI.

Contact me through email for an up-to-date résumé or to see my projects that can't be posted publically.

positions.title: Produce Team Member
positions.description: I worked as a part-time team member in the produce section of the Stauffers of Kissel Hill grocery store.

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
I was hired to do graphic design during a redesign of the company's marketing materials. I worked remotely, and I was primarily in charge of redesigning their annual yearbook from scratch. 
While I followed the style guide provided and frequently checked in for opinions on the design and layout, I had a lot of freedom to create something effective at my own discretion.
In addition to the yearbook, I designed and edited quite a few other graphics, photos, and marketing materials during my time with AHLI.
